correctness.rationale: For every finite connected simple rooted core H and all k>=2, nonnegative edgewise products establish that F^2(x)=x iff each edge sign reverses or remains zero; adjacent integer-gap bounds make core states finite modulo translation. The tail has exactly nine sign-pair states with local multiplicity m(a,b,c), a core boundary row alpha and terminal beta. Negating all signs reduces transfer to a four-dimensional bulk B with B^4-3B^3-2B^2-B+I=0 plus one flat eigenline whose coefficient equals Z(H,r). As primitive two-cycle states T=N-1, the quartic difference is -4(Z-1), giving universal homogeneous fifth-order after multiplying by shift-1. Independent exact arithmetic reconstructed K3 Z=3, boundary alpha=(14,21,28,4,3,4,28,21,14), N2...N7=(123,469,1675,6029,21771,78565), all yielding residual -8; no extrapolation from those samples supplies the all-core proof.
